Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad, Your servant

Arabic text: وَ رَسُولِكَ، وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ
Translation: And Your messenger, and his pure household

Arabic text: وَ اخْصُصْهُمْ بِأَفْضَلِ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ بَرَكَاتِكَ وَ سَلَامِكَ
Translation: And favor them with the best of Your blessings, mercy, benedictions, and peace

Arabic text: وَ اخْصُصِ اللَّهُمَّ وَالِدَيَّ بِالْكَرَامَةِ لَدَيْكَ
Translation: And O Allah, especially honor my parents with dignity from You

Arabic text: وَ الصَّلَاةِ مِنْكَ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
Translation: And blessings from You, O Most Merciful of the merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ أَلْهِمْنِيْ عِلْمَ مَا يَجِبُ لَهُمَا عَلَيَّ إِلْهَامًا
Translation: And inspire me with knowledge of what is due to them from me

Arabic text: وَ اجْمَعْ لِيْ عِلْمَ ذٰلِكَ كُلِّهِ تَمَامًا
Translation: And gather for me complete knowledge of all that

Arabic text: ثُمَّ اسْتَعْمِلْنِيْ بِمَا تُلْهِمُنِيْ مِنْهُ
Translation: Then make me act according to what You inspire in me

Arabic text: وَ وَفِّقْنِيْ لِلنُّفُوذِ فِيمَا تُبَصِّرُنِيْ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ
Translation: And help me to carry out what You reveal to me of that knowledge

Arabic text: حَتَّى لَا يَفُوتَنِيْ اسْتِعْمَالُ شَيْءٍ عَلَّمْتَنِيهِ
Translation: So that I may not fail to use anything You have taught me

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَثْقُلَ أَرْكَانِيْ عَنِ الْحَفُوفِ فِيمَا أَلْهَمْتَنِيهِ
Translation: And my limbs may not feel heavy in performing what You have inspired me

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: كَمَا شَرَّفْتَنَا بِهِ
Translation: As You have honored us through him

Arabic text: وَ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: And bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: كَمَا أَوْجَبْتَ لَنَا الْحَقَّ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ بِسَبَبِهِ
Translation: As You have made rights incumbent upon creation because of him

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِيْ أَهَابُهُمَا هَيْبَةَ السُّلْطَانِ الْعَسُوفِ
Translation: O Allah, make me fear them as one fears a harsh ruler

Arabic text: وَ أَبَرَّهُمَا بِرَّ الْأُمِّ الرَّؤُوفِ
Translation: And be dutiful to them with the devotion of a compassionate mother

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْ طَاعَتِيْ لِوَالِدَيَّ وَ بِرِّيْ بِهِمَا
Translation: And make my obedience to my parents and my dutifulness to them

Arabic text: أَقَرَّ لِعَيْنِيْ مِنْ رَقْدَةِ الْوَسْنَانِ
Translation: More delightful to my eyes than the sleep of the drowsy

Arabic text: وَ أَثْلَجَ لِصَدْرِيْ مِنْ شَرْبَةِ الظَّمْآنِ
Translation: And more soothing to my heart than a drink to the thirsty

Arabic text: حَتَّى أُوثِرَ عَلَى هَوَايَ هَوَاهُمَا
Translation: So that I may prefer their desires over my desires

Arabic text: وَ أُقَدِّمَ عَلَى رِضَايَ رِضَاهُمَا وَ أَسْتَكْثِرَ بِرَّهُمَا
Translation: And put their satisfaction before my satisfaction and consider their kindness to me as plentiful

Arabic text: بِيْ وَ اِنْ قَلَّ وَ أَسْتَقِلَّ بِرِّيْ بِهِمَا وَ اِنْ كَثُرَ
Translation: Even if it is little, and consider my kindness to them as little even if it is abundant

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ خَفِّضْ لَهُمَا صَوْتِي
Translation: O Allah, lower my voice before them

Arabic text: وَ أَطِبْ لَهُمَا كَلَامِي
Translation: And make my speech pleasing to them

Arabic text: وَ أَلِنْ لَهُمَا عَرِيكَتِي
Translation: And soften my conduct toward them

Arabic text: وَ اعْطِفْ عَلَيْهِمَا قَلْبِي
Translation: And make my heart compassionate toward them

Arabic text: وَ صَيِّرْنِيْ بِهِمَا رَفِيقًا، وَ عَلَيْهِمَا شَفِيقًا
Translation: And make me gentle with them and caring for them

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ اشْكُرْ لَهُمَا تَرْبِيَتِيْ، وَ أَثِبْهُمَا عَلَى تَكْرِمَتِي
Translation: O Allah, reward them for raising me, and recompense them for honoring me

Arabic text: وَ احْفَظْ لَهُمَا مَا حَفِظَاهُ مِنِّيْ فِيْ صِغَرِي
Translation: And protect for them all they protected for me in my childhood

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَ مَا مَسَّهُمَا مِنِّيْ مِنْ أَذًى، أَوْ خَلَصَ إِلَيْهِمَا عَنِّيْ مِنْ مَكْرُوهٍ
Translation: O Allah, whatever pain I have caused them, or harm that reached them from me

Arabic text: أَوْ ضَاعَ قِبَلِيْ لَهُمَا مِنْ حَقٍّ
Translation: Or right of theirs that I have neglected

Arabic text: فَاجْعَلْهُ حِطَّةً لِذُنُوبِهِمَا
Translation: Make it a remission of their sins

Arabic text: وَ عُلُوًّا فِيْ دَرَجَاتِهِمَا
Translation: And an elevation in their ranks

Arabic text: وَ زِيَادَةً فِيْ حَسَنَاتِهِمَا
Translation: And an increase in their good deeds

Arabic text: يَا مُبَدِّلَ السَّيِّئَاتِ بِأَضْعَافِهَا مِنَ الْحَسَنَاتِ
Translation: O You who transform evil deeds into manifold good deeds

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَ مَا تَعَدَّيَا عَلَيَّ فِيهِ مِنْ قَوْلٍ
Translation: O Allah, whatever they transgressed against me in speech

Arabic text: أَوْ أَسْرَفَا عَلَيَّ فِيهِ مِنْ فِعْلٍ
Translation: Or exceeded against me in action

Arabic text: أَوْ ضَيَّعَاهُ لِيْ مِنْ حَقٍّ، أَوْ قَصَّرَا بِيْ عَنْهُ مِنْ وَاجِبٍ
Translation: Or neglected of my rights, or fell short in their duties toward me

Arabic text: فَقَدْ وَهَبْتُهُ لَهُمَا، وَ جُدْتُ بِهِ عَلَيْهِمَا
Translation: I grant it to them and bestow it upon them

Arabic text: وَ رَغِبْتُ إِلَيْكَ فِيْ وَضْعِ تَبِعَتِهِ عَنْهُمَا
Translation: And I beseech You to remove its burden from them

Arabic text: فَإِنِّيْ لَا أَتَّهِمُهُمَا عَلَى نَفْسِي
Translation: For I do not accuse them regarding myself

Arabic text: وَ لَا أَسْتَبْطِئُهُمَا فِيْ بِرّي
Translation: Nor do I find them slow in their benevolence toward me

Arabic text: وَ لَا أَكْرَهُ مَا تَوَلَّيَاهُ مِنْ أَمْرِيْ يَا رَبِّ
Translation: Nor do I dislike what they have done for me, O my Lord

Arabic text: فَهُمَا أَوْجَبُ حَقًّا عَلَيَّ
Translation: They have more rights over me

Arabic text: وَ أَقْدَمُ إِحْسَانًا إِلَيَّ
Translation: And have done me favors for longer

Arabic text: وَ أَعْظَمُ مِنَّةً لَدَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أُقَاصَّهُمَا بِعَدْلٍ
Translation: And have greater favor upon me than that I should settle accounts with them justly

Arabic text: أَوْ أُجَازِيَهُمَا عَلَى مِثْلٍ
Translation: Or repay them equally

Arabic text: أَيْنَ إِذًا يَا إِلَهِيْ طُولُ شُغْلِهِمَا بِتَرْبِيَتِي
Translation: Where then, O my God, is their long labor in raising me?

Arabic text: وَ أَيْنَ شِدَّةُ تَعَبِهِمَا فِيْ حِرَاسَتِي
Translation: And where is the hardship of their toil in guarding me?

Arabic text: وَ أَيْنَ إِقْتَارُهُمَا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمَا لِلتَّوْسِعَةِ عَلَيَّ
Translation: And where is their self-denial to provide me with plenty?

Arabic text: هَيْهَاتَ مَا يَسْتَوْفِيَانِ مِنِّيْ حَقَّهُمَا
Translation: How far! They can never receive their full rights from me

Arabic text: وَ لَا أُدْرِكُ مَا يَجِبُ عَلَيَّ لَهُمَا
Translation: Nor can I fulfill what is due to them from me

Arabic text: وَ لَا أَنَا بِقَاضٍ وَظِيفَةَ خِدْمَتِهِمَا
Translation: Nor can I discharge the duty of serving them

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: So bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ أَعِنِّيْ يَا خَيْرَ مَنِ اسْتُعِينَ بِهِ
Translation: And help me, O Best of those whose help is sought

Arabic text: وَ وَفِّقْنِيْ يَا أَهْدَى مَنْ رُغِبَ إِلَيْهِ
Translation: And give me success, O Most Guiding of those to whom desires are expressed

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَجْعَلْنِيْ فِيْ أَهْلِ الْعُقُوقِ لِلْآبَاءِ وَ الْأُمَّهَاتِ
Translation: And do not make me among those who are undutiful to fathers and mothers

Arabic text: يَوْمَ تُجْزَى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَ هُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُوْنَ
Translation: On the day when every soul shall be rewarded for what it has earned, and they shall not be wronged

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ ذُرِّيَّتِهِ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad, his family, and his descendants

Arabic text: وَ اخْصُصْ أَبَوَيَّ بِأَفْضَلِ مَا خَصَصْتَ بِهِ
Translation: And favor my parents with the best You have favored

Arabic text: آبَاءَ عِبَادِكَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَ أُمَّهَاتِهِمْ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
Translation: The parents of Your believing servants, O Most Merciful of the merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ لَا تُنْسِنِيْ ذِكْرَهُمَا فِيْ أَدْبَارِ صَلَوَاتِي
Translation: O Allah, do not let me forget to remember them after my prayers

Arabic text: وَ فِيْ إِنًى مِنْ آنَاءِ لَيْلِي
Translation: And at times during my night

Arabic text: وَ فِيْ كُلِّ سَاعَةٍ مِنْ سَاعَاتِ نَهَارِي
Translation: And in every hour of my day

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ اغْفِرْ لِيْ بِدُعَائِيْ لَهُمَا
Translation: And forgive me through my supplication for them

Arabic text: وَ اغْفِرْ لَهُمَا بِبِرِّهِمَا بِيْ مَغْفِرَةً حَتْمًا
Translation: And forgive them through their goodness to me with a certain forgiveness

Arabic text: وَ ارْضَ عَنْهُمَا بِشَفَاعَتِيْ لَهُمَا رِضًى عَزْمًا
Translation: And be pleased with them through my intercession for them with a resolute pleasure

Arabic text: وَ بَلِّغْهُمَا بِالْكَرَامَةِ مَوَاطِنَ السَّلَامَةِ
Translation: And deliver them through Your honor to places of safety

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَ إِنْ سَبَقَتْ مَغْفِرَتُكَ لَهُمَا فَشَفِّعْهُمَا فِيَّ
Translation: O Allah, if Your forgiveness has preceded for them, then make them my intercessors

Arabic text: وَ إِنْ سَبَقَتْ مَغْفِرَتُكَ لِيْ فَشَفِّعْنِيْ فِيهِمَا
Translation: And if Your forgiveness has preceded for me, then make me their intercessor

Arabic text: حَتَّى نَجْتَمِعَ بِرَأْفَتِكَ فِيْ دَارِ كَرَامَتِكَ
Translation: So that we may gather together through Your kindness in the house of Your generosity

Arabic text: وَ مَحَلِّ مَغْفِرَتِكَ وَ رَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: And the place of Your forgiveness and mercy

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ ذُوْ الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ، وَ الْمَنِّ الْقَديِمِ، وَ أَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
Translation: Verily You are the Possessor of Boundless Grace and Ancient Favor, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful
